Subject: Capacity acceleration: ops handoff & QBR pulse

Hi Dana / Tom —

Thanks for the sync last week. Per our conversation, Acme is planning a mid-July capacity uplift (steady-state + short-term burst) and we want to get the internal handoff and a QBR on the calendar so execs have runway. High-level asks in this thread:

- Confirm the target start window (you mentioned around July 12–18).
- Share a short list of internal Acme stakeholders who should attend the QBR (ops, security, procurement, platform).
- Confirm rough token/throughput profile for steady-state vs burst (daily requests / p50 latency target).
- Agree on the mutual action plan (MAP) owners and a timeline for the term amendment (if needed).

I attached a first-pass MAP (MAP_v0.9.pdf) and a capacity forecast template (capacity_forecast_sheet.xlsx) — if you can drop numbers in the sheet we’ll use that to size Dedicated capacity and pricing options.

Proposed QBR windows (please pick 2):
- Tue Jul 13, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Jul 14, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu Jul 15, 09:00–10:00 PT

Next steps I’m proposing:
1) Acme fills the forecast sheet by EOD Wed May 20.
2) Redwood provides pricing scenarios (steady + burst) and an initial term amendment draft by Mon May 25.
3) Joint QBR (select one window above) to finalize run-rate and timeline.

Owners: I’ll own orchestration and the QBR deck; Marissa will own pricing & renewal terms; Ben will own onboarding/staffing ops; Karthik will be on legal/contract path.

Thanks — if this aligns I’ll drop a calendar poll and lock a slot.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Hi Dana / team —

I’ve drafted two pricing scenarios and attached them here (term_amendment_draft.docx). Highlights:

- Option 1 (Reserve + Overage): lower monthly reserve price, overage billed at 1.4x for burst tokens.
- Option 2 (Reserve + Burst Block): pre-paid burst block for 3 months at a 15% discount vs overage.
- 6-month ramp discount: we can provide a 10% credit applied monthly during the first 6 months if Acme commits to a 6-month uplift and signs the amendment within 30 days of the QBR.

Ben will follow up on the onboarding runbook and staffing assumptions; Karthik, if legal could review the amendment language I flagged, that would help us move faster.

Next steps:
- Dana to confirm QBR attendees and vote on the poll (link in thread).
- Acme to fill the capacity sheet by Wed May 20 EOD.
- Redwood to deliver final pricing + amendment language by Mon May 25.

I’ll attach the pricing doc to the HubSpot deal and pop the amendment draft into DocuSign when we have sign-off.
